correctness.rationale: RESULT.md lines 33–94: conditional on the uniform vertex, single and joint component membership require precisely the edges in the union of the paths from that vertex. Summing gives the four stated moments, and subtracting the products of the marginals gives the two covariance factors. The hub–leaf polynomial is strictly increasing on the positive half-line. The leaf–leaf polynomial is strictly convex, starts negative with negative derivative, and is positive at 1 for m≥3; for m=2 it factors as (p−1)(p²+4p+1), so its root at 1 is not an interior zero. The concave quadratic (H_m−L_m)/p has positive values at both endpoints, proving strict covariance ordering and separation of the interior thresholds. Rescaling the two polynomials at fixed x gives x²+x−1 and x³−1; their signs at points bracketing the simple positive roots give both limits. Independent exact replay of the four-vertex case: iterate the 8 edge masks and 4 uniform seeds, mark the seed's component, and count hub, leaf, two-leaf and hub–leaf indicators respectively 20, 16, 7 and 12 times among 32 equal outcomes. The covariances are 1/16 and −1/32. The reviewed checker and certificate describe finite samples, not an all-size certification. The mathematical statement applies only to the specified independent-edge graph model.
